name: 02109 · Boston, MA
findings: ZIP 02109 (Boston) has 355 nonprofit organizations. 104 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02109 (Boston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02109 (Boston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 18.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 90 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
